node.title: FLOOR CONJECTURE (BAND-DETERMINATION): the rate-1/2 band determination equals the first-moment prediction at every admissible razor row
node.statement: FLOOR RE-POSE v2 (2026-07-07, floor campaign; v1 SIGN ERROR CAUGHT SAME DAY before any attack ran — v1 said 'every band radius is safe-side', but the primary docs (P6_RATEHALF_SIBLING.md) show the band is the UNDETERMINED stretch between the proved deficit side (quotient windows, reach 2^33) and the proved safe side (above sigma* = 8,592,912,738); the band is not conjectured-safe): CORRECTED FLOOR — at every admissible rate-1/2 row in the razor slice (log2 q in (255.900, 256), the only rows where the band is nonempty), the band determination equals the first-moment prediction: true counts B(sigma) track the first-moment model through the band (deficit up to the first-moment crossing, safe above), i.e. the WINDOW LAW holds at the band radii — no structural surplus (which would move the crossing down... up) and no anti-concentration failure (which would move it the other way). All three consumers (adjacency_closing, list_adjacency_closing, mca_safe) need exactly the located determination; the 'new priced mechanism' demand is route (a mechanism is how you CERTIFY the band, not what is true there). Pre-registered falsifier: scaled rate-1/2 band-analogue rows where exact counts at band-analogue radii deviate from the first-moment model beyond Poisson, sustained across >= 3 scales — EITHER direction fires it; mechanism failures (AQB, dihedral sibling) do NOT count. Opening evidence: window law verified at every band-analogue probed campaign-wide; both dead routes died as mechanisms, never as count anomalies. | Strong full-determination target: cover the rate-1/2 residual band 2^33 < sigma <= sigma* by a genuinely new priced mechanism. AQB and the dihedral/Chebyshev sibling window are both refuted. A bracket-grade obstruction for some band radius would be a creditable partial result, but it does not satisfy this node as consumed by adjacency_closing, list_adjacency_closing, or mca_safe. | SURVIVAL +1 (2026-07-07, F6-A2, notes/f6a2_fullscale_sweep_modal.py): the composite-family attack channel (nested two-scale quotient stacks, full razor sweep, mpmath dps=40) scores ZERO hits — empty at every razor row. Retained refinement: the band is lq-GRADED (width ~0 at lq=255.900 rising to 2,978,146 at the cap; reach interpolates above 2^33 mid-slice). A preliminary 'band is a fixed-sigma* artifact' hypothesis was raised and KILLED in classification (the swept crossing was the random-word mean, not the worst-word pincer object — sigma* provenance: generic pincer, pro_brief_razor.md). | SURVIVAL +2 (2026-07-07, crossing-fidelity family): 18/18 exact determination matches vs the first-moment prediction across a 9-point q-ladder at sigma = 1,2, including through the crossing transition — the BAND-DETERMINATION floor's location claim verified throughout its accessible regime. | SURVIVAL +3 -> **HARDENED** (2026-07-07): word-class anti-concentration absent (min counts Poisson-ordinary across 60 layouts x 3 q x 2 cells). Families: composite-stack sweep / crossing-fidelity / anti-concentration. | SURVIVAL +4 (2026-07-07, Pro floor-window 6): genuine engagement, no kill — razor arithmetic replayed exactly (incl. an errata catch: our 255.95 band-width log line mixed columns; correct width 1,667,426); the multi-word amortization surface CLOSED as pure averaging (avg > T forces max > T; pooling gain cancels under normalization — 0 bits/fiber net, the AQB pattern); the pincer-at-cap route attempted without result and remains the floor's live open surface. | UPSTREAM DETERMINATION DATUM (2026-07-07, regime map, notes/correspondence/REGIME_MAP.md + nodes/rate_half_band_closure/notes/upstream_determination_datum.md): external crossing-fidelity evidence at n = 2^21 — upstream's four deployed adjacent pairs (KB MCA/list 1116047/1116046, M31 MCA/list 1116023/1116022) are first-moment crossing predictions (C(n,m) vs p^(m-K-s)*floor(q*eps), s = pencil shift) whose locations AND margins (22.197/22.011/3.259/3.073 bits) we replayed exactly by integer arithmetic. This is the floor's determination-location claim confirmed at a scale five orders beyond our q <= 1153 ladders (by upstream's proof, our replay). | WP5 KERNEL-BASIS VERDICT (2026-07-10, notes/kernel_basis/WP5_RATEHALF_VERDICT.md): does NOT conditionally close on row-sharp Q (side mismatch: the open content is deficit-side witnesses, no upper-bound theorem can cover a true-unsafe band; quantifier mismatch: K3's rows are n=2^21 extension fields vs the n=2^41 prime razor rows, transport NOTE-LEVEL). Own kernel minted: K5 razor-band witness kernel. Replay pinned sigma* = t*-1 = 8,592,912,738 exactly, cap reach 2^33 exact, band width 2,978,146; NEW open item OF THE FLOOR: the intended first-moment model is the worst-word/pincer object whose per-row crossing is not yet formalized (the random-word crossing is contradicted near the cap by the proved unsafe reach). || QUALITY CERT (2026-07-10, red-quality program): critical/nodes/rate_half_band_closure/QUALITY.md || WITNESS-HUNT RECON (2026-07-12, the early WP7 lane — roadmap addendum r1 amendment 3; scripts + the validated Modal launcher banked at notes/witness_hunt_20260712/): GAP ANATOMY EXACT — the razor need is 2^127.90..2^128.00, the deduped qcore plateau supplies C(127,64) = 2^123.1714, deficit 4.73..4.83 bits, FLAT across all 2,978,146 band cells (no easier sub-cell); tangent supplies 2^39.99, planted 127 (catch #103: tangent, not planted, is the dominant secondary column — 2^-88 of the need). THEOREM CAP: within the coset/dressing/perturbation universe the char-0 supply is capped at the plateau (Lam-Leung + NESTING — catch #102: order-2M cosets ARE pairs of order-M cosets, so multi-scale families dedup to C(127,64) ALONE; any sum-over-scales double-counts; verified in vivo, fiber = 3 = deduped not 4). NEW SUPPLY LAW (banked finding): for polynomial received words the complete list bijects with a truncated-locator moment-map fiber, and the generic-core law fiber = C(N-r, h) + Poisson background (r = cosets touched) holds EXACTLY in vivo — the banked one-coset core is optimal over the whole mechanism class. SEVEN candidate mechanisms triaged falsification-first: C1/C3/C4 re-params or dominated (exact bijections shown), C2 priced at O(1) vs 2^127.6 needed (divisor-quantized, satellite-29 phenomenology), C5/C6 vacuous at prime q, C7 = the killed dihedral route (NOT reopened; the fold arithmetic independently confirms the Pro T8 kill). WINDOW-LAW READ: first-moment + Poisson reproduced every count at 3 scales / ~200 primes / q to 2^40 including fine structure — the pre-registered falsifier's no-deviation direction. HONEST OPEN FLANK: non-polynomial received words (planted-hybrid at giant slack) are outside the fiber reduction and uncensused — the named residual hunt space. Sporadic escape hatch priced at ~2^-5.2 per razor row. || AMPLIFICATION FENCE (2026-07-12 wave-3; scope per catch #105): rate_half_multiplicative_amplification_floor PROVED — any multiplicative amplification route needs a factor ~2^91.85 at the slice top against the CAP PROXY (2^216 MCA-side trigger). SCOPE FACTS: the figure is q-GRADED (2^19.9 at lgq = 255.901, 2^2.6 at the slice bottom — exact computations banked) and it fences the NON-BINDING cap-proxy lane, not the binding eps* = 2^-128 list-side target (banked gap x28.4, kill line R1c) where the protection remains the mechanism kills. Dedup-safe (max over scales, catch #102); does not cut the pro-brief box-charge route; reopens nothing. || FIXED-CROSSING REFUTATION + RE-POSE (RH-ADJ) (wave-9 audited, 2026-07-17): the fixed rate-half crossing at sigma* is REFUTED (the cyclic count is s-independent; sigma_0 = 8,594,128,895 > sigma*+1 is also list-unsafe via the exact simple-pole conversion E(q,L) = L(q-n)/(q(q-n+kL)) > 2^-83). RE-POSED: find field-dependent a_RH(q) >= k + 8,594,128,896 with B_mca(a_RH) <= floor(q/2^128) < B_mca(a_RH - 1); safe side exactly = {B_ca^far <= B*, S_sparse <= B*} (proved lossless split; tangent absorbed for q >= 2^168). The LIST safe side is likewise OPEN (w9-C2 correction: the wave-8 'crossing DETERMINED' claim is withdrawn; unsafety proved through sigma_0). Full pose bodies + refutation.md in the node folder. [HISTORY: previous poses preserved in statement.md] || CROSSING DETERMINED BELOW 2^167 (wave-10 audited, 2026-07-18): for every admissible 2^128 < q < 2^167, a_RH(q) = n - floor(q/2^128) + 1, unconditional (quadratic staircase + (RQ4) + the Hankel far-CA layer + the universal coordinate-tangent unsafe witness). EXACT residual: budgets {2^39, 2^39+1}; beyond 2^167 brackets a_RH in [k+2^34, 3n/4 or n] (the k+2^34 optimized floor supersedes sigma_0 forward-facing). LIST side: safe side OWNED (rate_half_list_adjacent_crossing TARGET), crossing determined for budgets {1,2}, unsafe reach 2^34-1. Full reconciled narrative in statement.md. || DECOMPOSED (2026-08-09, user-directed; plan notes/band_decomposition_plan_20260809.md; executed at the round-27 bank): this node is now CONDITIONAL (gate all) on its two children — rate_half_band_structural_surplus (the K3/workboard arm: the enumerated supply cap, closing via the positive-433 board + the labels-to-slopes conversion + independent review) and rate_half_band_crossing_location (RH-AC: locate a_RH within the PROVED bracket [k+2^34, 3n/4]; S_sparse is the binding term; falsifiers F1/F2 + the F3 zero-power declaration). The retired FLOOR v2 two-directional falsifier splits per child (surplus direction -> child 1, re-scoped; the location content -> child 2's F1/F2). The consumers are unchanged (this node remains the conjunction point: adjacency_closing needs both halves located-adjacent; mca_safe's own inequality is HD1-dischargeable at q >= 2^169, premise-weakening a named follow-up). All prior poses and the round-27 corrections are preserved above and in statement.md.
